source_plan_constraints_preserved: First-attempt acceptance is scored only jointly with exact historical resolvability, preservation of negative claims, current binding correctness, and rejection of malformed current claims.

fixed_inputs.common_rule: Each fixture pair consists of one immutable synthetic input record consumed unchanged by both baseline and overlay, one precommitted expected-control record, and two already-materialized candidate-output records named baseline and overlay. The scorer never generates or rewrites either output.

input_conditions: A prior Episode contains a negative or unknown finding bound to historical bytes at a mutable path.
The current version of that path differs from the historical bytes.
An immutable historical commit/path locator and exact historical blob identity are present and resolvable from fixture-embedded bytes/metadata.
expected_controls: Historical observation is not restated as a current-byte assertion.
The historical locator resolves to bytes matching the declared historical blob identity before preservation is described as verified.
The prior negative or unknown finding and observation scope are retained.

input_conditions: A prior Episode contains a negative or unknown historical finding whose mutable path has changed.
The supplied historical locator cannot be resolved from the precommitted fixture material.
expected_controls: The unresolved historical reference is retained as prior evidence but is not described as verified.
The negative or unknown finding is not dropped or upgraded.

input_conditions: A current repository assertion carries a blob identity that is correct for the supplied bytes but a canonical-content digest/claim that is deliberately wrong.
A separate retained historical negative finding is also present so preservation is checked in the same fixture.
expected_controls: The malformed current canonical claim is rejected or explicitly marked invalid under unchanged validators.
A correct blob identity is not treated as certification of the wrong canonical claim.
Historical evidence handling does not weaken current-state validation.

unchanged_validators.rule: The scorer consumes the same precommitted validator-result fields for baseline and overlay and may not alter, bypass, relax, or reinterpret validator outcomes.

first_attempt_acceptance.pass: 1 only when the already-materialized output is accepted by the unchanged validator on its first evaluation attempt; otherwise 0. No retries or repaired second attempts count.

historical_resolvability.pass: 1 when every historical reference that the output describes as verified resolves to fixture-precommitted historical bytes matching the declared exact historical blob identity, and every intentionally unresolvable reference is explicitly marked unverified/limited rather than fabricated as resolved; otherwise 0.

negative_claim_preservation.pass: 1 when every precommitted negative or unknown prior finding remains present with its polarity, uncertainty and original scope preserved, with no upgrade to a positive/current assertion; otherwise 0.

current_binding_correctness.pass: 1 when every statement represented as current is bound to the fixture-declared current path/blob and passes the unchanged current-binding validator, with no stale historical tuple promoted to current; otherwise 0.

malformed_current_claim_rejection.pass: 1 when fixture_3's deliberately wrong canonical-content claim is rejected or explicitly marked invalid despite its correct blob identity; for fixtures without a malformed control the metric is 1 only when no malformed current claim is present; otherwise 0.

deterministic_decision_thresholds.fixture_pass: A baseline or overlay output passes a fixture iff all five binary metrics equal 1 for that fixture.
deterministic_decision_thresholds.protected_regression_gate: Overlay is immediately non-advancing if it scores 0 on any metric on any fixture that baseline scores 1 on, or if it alters/bypasses an unchanged validator outcome.
deterministic_decision_thresholds.overlay_advances_candidate_evidence: Only if overlay passes all three fixtures, baseline fails at least one fixture, the overlay has no protected regression, and the baseline failure is on one or more of historical_resolvability, negative_claim_preservation, current_binding_correctness, or malformed_current_claim_rejection rather than a missing/invalid fixture artifact.
deterministic_decision_thresholds.tie: If baseline and overlay both pass all three fixtures, record deterministic tie/no comparative novelty evidence.
deterministic_decision_thresholds.both_fail: If both fail any fixture, record insufficient comparative evidence; do not attribute the failure to candidate efficacy unless the exact metric difference isolates it.
deterministic_decision_thresholds.invalid_fixture: If a required fixture input, expected-control record, validator result, baseline output, or overlay output is absent or identity-mismatched, the scorer returns fixture_invalid and no comparative efficacy result.

zero_provider_call_execution_semantics.allowed_execution: Pure deterministic comparison over precommitted fixture records, exact byte/digest fields, unchanged validator results, and already-materialized baseline/overlay outputs. Repository API use, if any, is transport/readback only and not compute; the scorer must remain replayable from the materialized fixture package alone.
forbidden_execution: Generating baseline or overlay outputs during scoring
Calling a provider/model/API to infer missing fields
Mutating protected O authority or candidate activation state

bounded_slice.scope_guard: This specification is only for candidate-consolidation-historical-evidence-reference-v1 at the fixed protected-O head and the candidate's already-declared synthetic baseline-versus-overlay validation plan. It is not evidence that the overlay works, not repository-global novelty evidence, and not relevance or Phase-1 acceptance evidence.
bounded_slice.residual_work_or_protected_primary_execu: unresolved_upstream_pretrial_modelclient_dependency_preserved_from_predecessor; this specification itself introduces no new protected execution dependency
bounded_slice.finite_monthly_trial_paid_quota_dependen: not_eliminated_for_candidate efficacy by this specification; scorer design itself requires zero finite quota

exact_next_action: Fresh-bootstrap current manifest, RUN_LIFECYCLE, DESIRED_STATE and DOWNSTREAM_STATE; exact-read novelty/LATEST and verify this checkpoint remains the predecessor. Stay on candidate-consolidation-historical-evidence-reference-v1 only. Materialize exactly one role-local deterministic fixture-package schema that instantiates the three precommitted fixture pairs and the baseline/overlay/validator-result field identities consumed by this scorer spec, without generating outputs, executing the scorer, calling any provider/model, mutating protected O, changing validators/prompts, touching CLEAN explorer state/feedback, integrator wave/index/feed, or scheduler. Preserve zero-cost/zero-quota semantics and exact tested scope.
